fusions.name: Burrow Breaks Open
fusions.desc: The ground under you breaks open: it deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks each back 2.5 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave each [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Potter's Flung Jar
fusions.desc: Throws a clay pot at a target up to 6 tiles away. It deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at maximum range, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Daubed Rampart
fusions.desc: Raises a wall of mud 5 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Walled-In Larder
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
